name: Illicit consent grant attack
short_description: An illicit consent grant attack tricks a user into granting an attacker-controlled OAuth application permissions such as mail or file access, giving the app account-level access to data without stealing a password.

evidence.quote: the twist, OAuth consent grant attack, the attacker didn't break in, the victim opened the door
We'll track consent fishing, token theft and OAuth abuse.
First, consent grant to a malicious multi-tenant app.
What illicit consent grants actually are, and why MFA fails.
